_comment: Second half — run against the SAME session key right after episode-supersede-initial's turn:1 completes. A completely unrelated *simple* task (log rotation, not the DB migration), so ClassifyRequest returns continues_prior=false and the turn takes the Lite lane. OpenEpisode closes turn:1's still-open episode as 'superseded' (dispatching its RecordSkillOutcome, outcome=failure) and opens NO episode for turn:2 (Lite). episode-supersede-followup.expect.sh checks turn:1's episode was superseded + recorded and turn:2 has no episode.
